products.branch: Liquid whole hen's egg — shell-free homogenized whole contents, not separated albumen or yolk
products.pesticide_name: Sum of benomyl and carbendazim expressed as carbendazim
products.legal_scope: named whole egg form consisting of hen egg white plus yolk, after shell removal; processing may alter residues
required_evidence: Identify Gallus gallus whole-egg subtype using FSSR 2.5.3 and actual finished product declaration; exclude separated albumen, separated yolk and additives altering analytical matrix
Match live manufacturing composition, pasteurization, freezing, any desalting/desugaring, moisture/solids and preservation to the shell-free eggs sample basis
Establish the pesticide residue definition, relevant processing/concentration factor and sample preparation approved for this finished product
Recheck effective amendments after 03.02.2026 and complete the full chemical, microbiology and ingredient risk requirements
Obtain accredited laboratory evidence for the specific sold lot before evaluating compliance
negative_controls: A ready-to-eat formula containing eggs as an ingredient
